title: Telegram tools
description: Agent tools for Telegram chats: messages, media, albums, files, topics, pins, forwards and polls. This add-on is optional and separate from the Telegram bot and Telegram groups transports, so an agent gets Telegram tools only when an admin grants this pack to that agent. Connect the bot the agent should act as; the transport add-ons keep owning long polling, pairing and routing. Using the same bot token here as in a transport add-on is safe because this add-on never calls getUpdates.

permissions.reason: Call the Telegram Bot API as the connected bot
Resolve the bot token bound to the telegram-bot connection owned by this add-on
Read workspace files to send them to Telegram
Save files downloaded from Telegram into the organization workspace

fields.label: Default chat
fields.help: Used when a tool call omits chat. Accepts a numeric chat id, a -100… supergroup id, @username, or chatId:topicId to post into a forum topic.

fields.label: Allowed chats
fields.help: Chat ids or @usernames the agent may touch, separated by commas or new lines. Empty means every chat the bot can reach. A chat is matched by its id or its @username, so listing @name allows the same chat by -100… id and the other way round. Calls to any other chat fail with permission_denied.

fields.label: Read-only
fields.help: Reject every tool that posts, edits, deletes, forwards or pins. get_chat, get_file and download_file keep working, so an agent can inspect chats and pull files without writing.

fields.label: Per-bot rules (JSON)
fields.help: Optional JSON object keyed by bot label or account id, for setups with several bots. Each entry may set allowed_chats, read_only and default_chat; a missing key falls back to the fields above. Example: {"@sales_bot": {"allowed_chats": ["-100123"], "read_only": true}, "@ops_bot": {"default_chat": "@ops"}}

descriptor.name: telegram
descriptor.title: Telegram tools
descriptor.description: Chats, messages, media, albums, files, topics, polls, pins and forwards as one of the connected Telegram bots

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: List the Telegram bots connected to this add-on: account id (use it as bot in other tools), label, Telegram bot id, status and effective rights (read_only, default_chat, allowed_chats). Call it first when several bots are connected.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List the chats the selected bot is allowed to use, with id, type (private, group, supergroup, channel), title and username, hydrated through getChat. The list comes from the bot rules, Default chat and Allowed chats settings, because the Telegram Bot API cannot enumerate the chats a bot belongs to; entries carry default: true for the Default chat, restricted: false when no allow-list is set, and per-entry error text when Telegram rejects a chat.

bot.description: Bot to act as: account id, label from list_bots, or Telegram bot id. Required when several bots are connected

tools.name: get_chat
tools.description: Read a chat the bot can reach: id, type, title, username and pinned message id. chat accepts a numeric id, a -100… supergroup id, @username or chatId:topicId; when omitted the add-on Default chat is used.

bot.description: Bot to act as: account id, label from list_bots, or Telegram bot id. Required when several bots are connected

chat.description: Chat id, -100… supergroup id, @username or chatId:topicId

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a chat, optionally into a forum topic and as a reply. Text up to 4096 characters, sent as plain text unless parseMode is set; the add-on does not escape markup. Returns the new messageId.

chat.description: Chat id, -100… supergroup id, @username or chatId:topicId

replyToMessageId.description: Message id to reply to, numeric

parseMode.description: Telegram parse mode; omit for plain text

linkPreview.description: Set false to hide the link preview

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit the text of a message the bot posted. Text up to 4096 characters. Editing with unchanged text fails as conflict.

bot.description: Bot to act as: account id, label from list_bots, or Telegram bot id. Required when several bots are connected

chat.description: Chat id, -100… supergroup id, @username or chatId:topicId

messageId.description: Message id returned by a send, numeric

tools.name: send_media
tools.description: Send one file as a photo, video or document. Pass exactly one of url, workspace path or dataBase64; files up to 5 MB, public urls are fetched by Telegram. Returns the new messageId and the Telegram fileId, which can be reused by other tools.

tools.description: Send 2 to 10 photos, videos or documents as one album with an optional caption. Pass urls or workspace paths, not both; each item up to 5 MB.
